in_sanskrit.name: हृतिक

in_marathi.name: Hrutik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे He who protects
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrutik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit root hruth, which means protection, the name Hrutik denotes one who protects, guards or safeguards. In Hindu mythology, Hrutik is the name of a deity who is believed to protect the heart, guarding it against negative emotions and malevolent influences.

in_bengali.name: Hrutik

In Hindu mythology, Hrutik is the name of a deity who is believed to protect the heart, guarding it against negative emotions and malevolent influences.
